title: Seitan Ukrainian Wrap
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian-inspired wrap filled with seitan and vegetables.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tsp of oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, shredded cabbage, and chopped green onions. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the seitan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the tahini and lemon juice.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the seitan mixture onto the center of each wrap, then drizzling with the tahini-lemon sauce.
